repair_feedback: INT-C7-REPAIR-F1-FIX: Replace the InMemoryConfirmedPlanStore with a durable storage mechanism so the confirm→apply flow survives across Wix serverless invocations. The current in-memory Map assumes single-instance execution, which contradicts the binding recon evidence (Wix-managed serverless with automatic scaling). Repair must persist the confirmed plan record so that POST /apply-plan can retrieve it from a different cold-started instance. Additionally harden by: (F3) recomputing the confirmation hash server-side from the canonical plan serialization and rejecting mismatches, (F5) deriving confirmedBy from the verified caller token instead of trusting the client. F4 (confirm-diff validation) may be addressed opportunistically. The repair must preserve the existing 31 passing confirm-diff/apply-plan tests, add tests for cross-invocation durability and hash-integrity rejection, and maintain deterministic checks green.
